# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/test_huntr_form.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.huntr_form — build the 12 huntr submission form fields
from a Finding + PoC + context. Imports ngv2.contracts; pure stdlib."""
from ngv2.contracts import Finding, PoC
from ngv2.huntr_form import HUNTR_FORM_FIELDS, CWE_VULN_TYPES, build_form


FINDING = Finding(id='MDB-1', target='berriai/litellm', category='CWE-918',
                  severity='high', title='SSRF in proxy', description='User URL reaches request()')
POC = PoC(finding_id='MDB-1', language='python', code='import requests; requests.get(URL)',
          entrypoint='exploit')
CONTEXT = {
    'package_manager': 'pypi',
    'affected_package': 'litellm',
    'version': '1.40.0',
    'cvss_vector': 'AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N',
    'impact': 'Server-side request forgery to internal services.',
    'occurrences': ['https://github.com/berriai/litellm/blob/abc/proxy.py#L410'],
}


def test_form_fields_constant():
    assert HUNTR_FORM_FIELDS == (
        'repository', 'package_manager', 'affected_package', 'version',
        'vulnerability_type', 'severity', 'cvss_vector', 'title',
        'description', 'poc', 'impact', 'occurrences',
    )


def test_cwe_vuln_types_maps_known_cwes():
    assert CWE_VULN_TYPES['918'] == 'Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)'
    assert CWE_VULN_TYPES['89'] == 'SQL Injection'


def test_build_form_has_all_fields():
    form = build_form(FINDING, POC, CONTEXT)
    assert set(form.keys()) == set(HUNTR_FORM_FIELDS)


def test_build_form_values():
    form = build_form(FINDING, POC, CONTEXT)
    assert form['repository'] == 'berriai/litellm'
    assert form['package_manager'] == 'pypi'
    assert form['affected_package'] == 'litellm'
    assert form['version'] == '1.40.0'
    # CWE-918 -> mapped huntr vulnerability type
    assert form['vulnerability_type'] == 'Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)'
    assert form['severity'] == 'high'
    assert form['cvss_vector'] == CONTEXT['cvss_vector']
    assert form['title'] == 'SSRF in proxy'
    assert form['description'] == 'User URL reaches request()'
    assert form['poc'] == POC.code
    assert form['impact'] == CONTEXT['impact']
    assert form['occurrences'] == CONTEXT['occurrences']


def test_build_form_unknown_cwe_falls_back_to_category():
    f = Finding(id='1', target='t', category='CWE-99999', severity='low', title='x', description='d')
    form = build_form(f, POC, CONTEXT)
    assert form['vulnerability_type'] == 'CWE-99999'
```
